answer: The profile is re-verified with a random swipe prompt each epoch. Forging 124 swipe profiles costs 124 distinct touch behaviors, since synthetic swipes lack the micro-tremor of a real hand. Touchscreen swipes are profiled by curvature, velocity and pressure variance across the gesture. Watch the violet: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the anchor bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the trellis audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
